item.title: Truck driver killed in tragic Pacific Highway accident
item.description: Police investigations into the incident are ongoing. Image: NSW Police A truck driver has died in a tragic incident on Sydney’s Upper North Shore earlier this morning. Emergency services were called to the northbound on-ramp of the Pacific Highway, Wahroonga, at 4.25am, after reports of a crash. Police were told a driver had been hit after their refrigerated truck had rolled onto them. A nearby driver entered the vehicle and pulled the emergency brake to stop the truck from entering traffic.
